text: Don Nichols, Manager, Grants Unit and Aisha Silim, Manager, Renters Strategy Unit from the Housing Secretariat will provide a presentation on the availability of resources, services and support for tenants who are at risk of displacement and an update on the launch of the new Situation Table for Housing-at-Risk (STAR) in response to Item HS6.3 .
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
